field_changes.old: This latest release adds cooking mode to recipes. Cooking mode keeps your screen awake and makes it easier to keep track of ingredients and directions as you're cooking.
field_changes.new: This latest release makes it even easier to keep track of what you’ve eaten. Check out your daily nutrition progress, build a meal-tracking streak, and review your consistency with the new monthly tracking calendar.
